title: TUF Timestamp Metadata Schema
description: JSON Schema for TUF timestamp metadata files that list the hashes and size of the snapshot metadata file

_type.description: The metadata type identifier. Always 'timestamp' for timestamp metadata.

spec_version.description: The version of the TUF specification this metadata conforms to. Should follow semantic versioning.

version.description: Version number of this timestamp metadata instance. Must be incremented for each new version.

expires.description: Expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Clients must reject metadata after this time.

meta.description: Dictionary containing metadata about the snapshot file.

snapshot.json.description: Metadata information about the snapshot.json file.

version.description: Version number of the referenced metadata file.

length.description: Length of the metadata file in bytes.

hashes.description: Dictionary of cryptographic hashes for the metadata file.
